lines.en: HEY, PARTY PEOPLE. WHAT RHYMES WITH “MAID: LADOW SHEGENDS?”
: Hey-hey-ho! Those clothes have got to go! Why are you still dressed? We’ll never win if I’m the only one in uniform.

: First and foremost, that is definitely not true because our class has way more bi girls than I ever thought it did and I can guarantee you that all of them will react to seeing this the way I am right now.
: Which is?
: It’s something I can not speak of in a locker room, but still! That uniform is more than enough and there is no fucking way I can wear that, Chika! I want to get married some day!
: Me too! Which is precisely why you’ve gotta try stuff like this out so you know what you can pull off when the time comes for kinky bedroom stuff.
: “Kinky bedroom stuff” is not a thing I feel safe discussing in a locker room either.

: Rin, chill. What do you have to lose? We’re both hot as hell and we should be using that to our advantage since we were chosen for this competition only thirty minutes ago and have not practiced at all.
: Right now, our looks are all we have going for us. Especially since Uta’s already proven herself as a freestyle master who can probably just come up with some awesome cheer on the fly.
: I don’t care how hot you’re pretending I am right now, I’m not you. There’s no way I can pull that off. It’s way too risque.
: I’m the cute but wholesome type. You’re the stylish sex goddess. Just put me in a...hat or something. You can wear the skimpy bra-style cheerleading outfits while I do...hat stuff.
: You’re gonna have to do a lot of hat stuff if you want to compete with this, I think.
: Yeah. I’m well aware.
: Are you just...too embarrassed or something? Because you shouldn’t be. Plus, chances are you’d be the star if we both wore this anyway. Your boobs are bigger and nicer than mine.
: Bigger, maybe. But-
: Oh, it’s not a maybe. They’re bigger. I’ve spent significantly more time than you’re probably aware of looking at them.
: Is this sexual harassment?
: Only if I touch you.
: I don’t think that’s how it-
: Ka-cha!
: Would you stop that already?!
: Rin, regardless of the embarrassment or whatever it is that’s preventing you from joining me in this irrefutably refined style choice, I want you to know that I think you’re adorable.
: I’m a firm believer in the “Flaunt it if you’ve got it” lifestyle. And you, girl- you’ve got it. But hey, I won’t make you do anything you’re uncomfortable with if you don’t want to.
: I do think we have to do something, though. Because, at this rate, those two are going to wipe the floor with us.
: Why Yasu, though?
: I have no clue, but I’ve got this crazy urge to snatch her up and take her home with me right now.
: Okay, at least I’m not alone in feeling that.
: It seems like they’re going for the traditional “cute” strategy. So again, if we really want to emphasize our greatest “features,” we’ll-
: Ka-cha!
: Hey! Give me my pom-pom back!
: Yasuyasu, why are you so nervous? You look great!
: I look like a sinner!
: I am not permitted to wear such revealing clothing! Only in the process of transference can I don less than His chosen dresses!
: Uhh...okay! What’s this transference thingy then? Something I can help with?
: Do you have a penis?
: I did not think so...
: It’s not polite to ask people if they have a penis, Yasuyasu.
: I apologize. I will repent for three hours once the competition ends. I will no longer ask about penises.
: It’s fine, it’s fine. But...just...outta curiosity...if I did have one...were you gonna like...you know...
: Are you interested in hearing about the act of transference? Because it is my duty to inform all of those who wish to know.
: I mean...we’ve only got a few minutes until the competition starts. So if you can keep it brief, sure.
: It is a holy ritual in which light is transferred from a male vessel into a female via sexual intercourse, and then back into Him as the ultimate result of that!
: Back...into him?
: Him as in the One Who Never Sees But Still Sees All.
: Oh...And...And that light is transferred...
: From the penis. But I would not engage in the ritual with you without first examining your aptitude and receiving His approval.
: Yasuyasu.
: Yes?
: Please never repeat this to anyone who actually has a penis. Okay?
: But then how else will they learn?
: They won’t.
: Then what will they do with all of their light?
: Probably shoot it out into a sock or something.
: A sock?...
: Utaaaaaa!
: Uhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh hi?!
: Rin stole my pom-pom and won’t take her clothes off for meeeee...I’m sad.
: You can have it back for the thing! And I told you I’d wear the normal uniform! Just not that one!
: You’d have worn this uniform with me...right, Uta? You don’t think I look too...impure do you?...
: Uhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh...
: Stop sabotaging the second floor and come get changed!
: S...Sabotage?
: Love you!
: Your scent has changed...You yearn for the light.
: You have no idea how right you are.
: Okay, girls! Now that you’re all dressed and ready to go, allow me to explain the rules of this competition!
: No need! We’ve already accepted defeat!
: No we haven’t!
: Fifty bucks if you let my daughter win. She’s the one in blue who looks like she’s adopted.
: Keep your filthy, American money away from me. It’s probably all crumpled and sticky and was shoved in some stripper’s thong at some point.
: I mean, yeah. That’s why it’s sticky.
: We’re gonna mix things up this time around and allow Wakana to choose the winner of the competition since there’s no clear way to tell who was better or worse!
: Unless one pair of you really sucks! But even if you do, we won’t tell you that because we want to be supportive!
: And Chika! Thank you for not wearing the slutty cheerleader outfit! That was placed in the locker room as a trap and would have been an instant disqualification!
: Ha!
: Hey, we’re gonna lose anyway. At least that one would have made us turn heads.
: Assuming that none of you have put a decent amount of practice into your routines given poor planning on Rika’s end, definitely not mine, just do your best to come up with a decent cheer, okay?!
: Hey, wait a second. I didn’t plan anything. That was your job.
: I know that. You know that. Wakana knows that. The girls don’t need to know that, though. They keep telling me I’m doing a good job today and I don’t want that to stop.
: So you throw your friend under the bus instead?
: Buses are heavy, you know. And I’m not as good at crawling as I used to be.
: And I’m not as good at kissing as I used to be- which is the only reasonable explanation for why you gave me a six out of ten.
: But I already gave you the explanation for that. The amount of tongue was just-
: Okay! You can start whenever you’re ready! Floor one goes first because they look less prepared!
: I bet you’re a six out of ten at sex too.
: Probably lower. It’s been so long since Imani’s gotten laid that she’s likely forgotten what to do in the first place.
: Hahah! Having friends is so awesome!
: How long is “so long” exactly? Because I’ve lost track of how many months it’s been for me and, if you’re going insane over there, I feel you.
: Oh, not that long.
: Seven years.
: Hey! Thanks, Wakana! I’m really glad you made it a point to remember the exact number! You’re such a good friend!
: YEARS?!
: You too, Rika! Love you guys!
: YEARS?!?!
: It’s been so long that you’re practically a virgin again.
: Not how that works!
: YEARS?!
: Stop repeating it! No one hates this more than I do!
: Hold on one second. I have to do something.
: Do what?! What are you-
: Taco Man! I’ll give you fifty bucks to screw my friend!
: I don’t want to fuck the taco guy! And why are there so many exceptions to the no-boys rule?!
: Taco Man, Imani. And don’t yell at Rika. You know she’s just trying to help.
: I don’t need her help getting laid!
: You need all of our help getting laid. And you’d think that this would be an easy task given that we’re all interested in women.
: But alas, sleeping with any of us could potentially disrupt the dynamic of our friend group. Which is why it appears your only options are Arakawa or the Taco Man.
: Senpai’s part of our friend group too, you know. He’s not excluded just because he’s got a dick.
: You’re right. But he’s also hesitant to have sex with you because he’s afraid of what would become of your relationship.
: He’d probably nail the rest of you, though. How come I have to be the odd one out?
: Only time will tell, Imani.
: But until then, there’s always the Taco Man.
: I’m not gonna fuck the Taco Man!
: Hey-hey-ho! Our teachers do not know! We can do whatever cheer we want since all of them are...not listening to us!
: Shouldn’t we at least rhyme, still? Miss Watabe could be listening in and she’s a big poetry buff. And even if she’s not, we might be able to, like...subconsciously impress her or something.
: Sure! But I’m kind of bad at coming up with rhymes. So how about you handle all of the heavy lifting and I just do the easy parts?
: How heavy is this going to be, exactly? Because I’ve got work in the morning and-
: Hey-ho-hey! Rin is kinda gay!
: Gay...goo...guck. There are girls I want to...fuck?
: Wow. You’re terrible at this.
: You think I don’t know that?! I wasn’t even supposed to be in this competition! I’m only here because you refused to do it without me and we needed your sex appeal to have a chance!
: Okay, sure. But “gay-goo-guck?” What the hell is gay-goo-guck?
: A cheer! You said we could say whatever we want since no one is listening!
: Yeah, within reason. Like, watch.
: If you’re having girl problems, I feel bad for you, son. I’ve got 99 problems but a cheer ain’t one!
: That’s just a Jay-Z song but with “cheer” added into it!
: Yeah and no one cares! Now you try!
: W...Wonder where you went when we passed and graduated...Taking class, making cash doing...cheer...
: That’s not Jay-Z as well, is it?
: Hot Mulligan. Cock Party 2.
: What?
: It was better than the first.
: There have been multiple cock parties?
: Yeah, and the second one was better. Can we stop now?
: Yeah. I think it’d be best if we just left this one up to fate and chalked this up to being a good bonding experience.
: Which means it’s our turn, Yasuyasu! Spin around and face the same direction as me!
: I...I don’t know if I can do this!
: Sure ya can! Just repeat everything I say, okay?
: But if they are words that do not coincide with the beliefs of The Lightsink, repeating them could relinquish my role as a messenger!
: Then, I guess...don’t repeat them if the words are bad!
: Pom-poms out, okay? Like this.
: My arms only bend backwards.
: Don’t lie to me, Yasuyasu.
: It’s not a lie. There is a barrier of unseen evil preventing me from doing what you are doing.
: Then, can you at least shake them a little bit? And still repeat after me?
: I will do my best to not disappoint you like the worm I am.
: D-O-R-M! First-floor girls we shall condemn!
: And with His great, unrivaled power, we shall strike them down and-
: W-A-R-S! Floor one sucks! Floor two’s the best!
: There is a thick, pungent fog covering the halls of the first floor that has ridden in on the unclean shoes of-
: Y-A-S-U! Repeat my words, you silly goose!
: The goose is a sinful creature that basks in the shadow of doubt and can never understand what it means to-
: C-H-E-R! That’s what we do! That’s who we are!
: ...Cher?
: D-O-O-M! Heed my call! We’ll destroy them!
: G-O-D...Woo. God is good and...God is He!
: K-I-L-L!
: No one! No more blood shall spill!
: P-E-C-E!
: Does not spell peace! God is still He!
: Y-A-S-U!
: That is my name! Yasu-yasu!
: See, Yasuyasu?! I knew you could do it! You just had to believe in yourself!
: Thinking about the church gave me the strength I needed to persevere and overcome the adversity that is “cheerleading!”
: Sure! That works too!
: I just hope the teachers were listening. Because it looks like they’re still arguing about stuff over there.
: The first thing you should have told me was that it’d been seven years, Imani! I could have put you out of your misery before I was added to the friend group! Now it would just be weird!
: Sorry, Rika! I was too busy being a terrible kisser to think of that! Question, though! Is a 43 year old like you even able to do it anymore?! Because I’m afraid you’d break a hip!
: 42! And you take that back! I have the strongest hips out of anybody I know! I bet you don’t even go to the gym!
: I don’t have to! I’m young!
: You’ll eat those words in ten years, damn it! We’re all invincible until we hit our 30s! Wakana knows! Right, Wakana?!
: Wakana’s 28, you moron!
: Wait, this Wakana? She’s only 28? How does she already look so dead inside?
: I imagine all those years of “literally being dead inside” have taken a toll on her.
: Uhh...Miss Watabe? Sorry to interrupt, but...are you still judging the cheer contest? Because we’ve been done for a little while now and-
: Oh, crap. I completely forgot.
: Well, you’re in luck because I didn’t. The victory quite obviously goes to the second floor — the only one who actually tried. Well done, Ushibori.
: You’re not 28. You’re lying to all of us. How can we call you a friend when we don’t even know who you are?
: Sorry, guys. I’ll start setting up the next event now. So if one of you wants to give like, a...winner’s speech in the meantime, feel free.
: Yasuyasu, there was something you wanted to tell everyone, wasn’t there?
: Oh! Um...yes...
: To the girls of Class A...
: I know that you are all far superior to me and that hearing my voice is likely akin to hearing nails on a chalkboard...
: But...I am...
: I am looking for...anyone who might be interested in hearing about my beliefs in a more...structured and...and...
: Safe.
: A more structured and safe environment where I can...teach you about my religion without making it sound like I am trying to save-
: Convert.
: Without making it sound like I am trying to convert you. I respect...all of you...regardless of what you believe and...um...
: I would like to become your friend...if you are willing to tolerate me...
: What was that, Yasu? It’s a little hard to hear you with the pom-pom covering your-
: I would like to become friends with all of you!
